## Vendor independence (your call, now enforced)
`@rork-ai/toolkit-sdk` is gone from `expo/package.json`, `node_modules`, and `metro.config.js`. The build config is now self-contained Expo tooling only, so an APK/AAB/web bundle can be produced on any machine. Gate suite: 12/12.

## What the 18 actually were
Only 6 were real product bugs. The rest were the harness lying to you:

- **Vendor (4)** — real. Fixed above.
- **Chat (8)** — not app bugs. The audit ran `bun test expo backend` from the repo root, which skips `expo/bunfig.toml`, so every expo test file crashed on import (`__DEV__ is not defined`). Run from `expo/`, all 8 passed untouched.
- **Wires (4)** — real. `createWire` threw because the AES-256-GCM key only existed by leaking in from a sibling test file, so wire encryption passed or failed depending on file order. Now has a dedicated test key; encryption really runs.

Fixing those exposed that **the backend suite was never finishing**. The intent-router test called `process.exit(1)` on failure, killing the process partway — 45 tests after it never ran and silently counted as "passing."
